tldr: Mercury in the 4th house: your mind and communication focus on home, family, and roots
body: Mercury in the 4th house: your mind and communication focus on home, family, and roots. Gift: sharp thinking there. Watch: overthinking it. With Mercury in the 4th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. This makes what makes you feel rooted, protected, and emotionally held a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through home and roots.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in home and roots.
